claim.quote: We present the all-particle energy spectrum, based on 7 seasons of operation.

date.note: Year of the journal publication, read from the arXiv journal reference; the preprint was posted on arXiv on 8 April 2021.

name: All-particle energy spectrum from Tunka-133

official_url.quote: The primary cosmic-ray energy spectrum measured with the Tunka-133 array

summary.plain: Tunka-133 measured the overall energy spectrum of cosmic rays between 6 × 10¹⁵ and 10¹⁸ eV from the blue flash of air showers recorded over seven winter seasons in a Siberian valley.
summary.technical: All-particle spectrum from the Cherenkov light flux at 200 m core distance, 7 seasons (2175 h of good-weather operation, about 1.4 × 10⁷ events), covering 6 × 10¹⁵ to 10¹⁸ eV.

title: The primary cosmic-ray energy spectrum measured with the Tunka-133 array
why_it_matters: The abstract describes the time and amplitude calibration and the event reconstruction methods and presents the all-particle spectrum over 6 × 10¹⁵ to 10¹⁸ eV; the TAIGA collaboration later reports features such as a change of index near 20 PeV.
